name: moat_island_grass
notes: A square moat about 88 m across with an off-centre island and two 10 m stone bridges, one leaving NORTH and one leaving EAST -- a LANDFORM pattern: the cut (relief, radius 64 m, feather 10), the water plane in it (164 cm under the base level, copied cell for cell: 1,746 cells of plane for about 1,000 submerged), the source collision inside r 54 (moat blocked, both decks and the island open) and the paint. Three records about the moat's centre (108, 246): the two bridges at bias -270/-280 -- they hang from the moat BED under their origin, which the relief reproduces -- and one tree on the island. The author picked it on three maps that share the terrain (empirecastle, empirewar01 snow, empirewar02 grass: same plane, relief within 22 cm on average); empirewar03 has a desert yard there instead. Turn it with rotate_deg like anything else; roads should arrive at the north and east bridge heads, 27 m from the pivot. Keep other pads and roads' levelling out of the radius. THIS ONE: metin2_map_empirewar02, the grass version -- b1-024-10m-bridge, a Monterey cypress; empirewar/summer/stone03 lining the moat, field01 and field03 paths.
